comments.note: makeTestConfig() uses an implicit return type. storage-init.test.ts introduced the pattern of annotating this helper with the explicit ': AppConfig' return type, which causes a compile-time error if AppConfig gains a required field. Consider applying the same annotation here for consistency and early-detection safety.

makeManager() pre-creates config.storageFolder with fs.mkdirSync, but this is technically redundant: RepositoryManager.add() calls writeJsonFile which calls ensureDirectory internally. The pre-creation is harmless and mirrors production setup order (initializeStorage before manager use), so this is an acceptable pattern — no change needed. Documenting for future contributors who may wonder why it is there.
